composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. creative_direction: Draw a small cat and teacup with one warm-brown line, letting a single steam curve become the cat's tail. Tilt the face slightly above the cup and reserve a tiny sage cheek patch. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
